description: Review Regenerate follows the entire workout (REQ-023; C50, G15; R05; AC-C50-01; JOURNEY-023). On the real /review route Review's existing Regenerate action, now the exported owner ReviewRegenerateAction (src/app/Review.tsx), is the last item of the scrolling content: after every section, including the Cooldown guide (TASK-022's PreparationGuide) down to its last movement, with nothing readable below it and Start still pinned in the footer. Its behaviour and navigation are unchanged: it asks first with RegenerateConfirmDialog, Keep it / Escape keep the workout, confirming runs the route's existing regeneration (the generation run with its Cancel landing on Nothing to review), and it is held while Start is in flight. The accepted gallery state /gallery/refinements?state=preparation (reference eded158cfd928d382c9a9409e2c372270312741d) draws the same owner after its Cooldown, asking with Review's own confirmation and discarding nothing. check-01 selects the AC-021 block of the shared src/app/review-screen.test.tsx (its primary placement case included); check-02 proves the route in the browser at 320 and 390 with a contained synthetic session, touch, keyboard, reduced motion, a failed Start, a reload and the absent hand-off. Every declared case must execute and pass.

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-023 --check check-01 -- npx vitest run src/app/review-screen.test.tsx --testNamePattern "AC-021" --passWithNoTests=false
